quotes.text: We did the Sunset Cruise, absolutely amazing, Staff was just awesome......Grace, Tamiko, Taylor and Captain Travis...and a special shout out to, Jake who entertained my 4 year old daughter and made her birthday!! Also let Mom and Dad enjoy the Sunset!!! A definite must do!!!

This was our favorite experience during our two weeks in Hawaii. Great friendly crew, good lunch. The whole thing felt relaxed and lovely. We went snorkeling and we saw a turtle. This really made us happy. The pick up from the hotel was also very good.

If you are looking for a sunset cruise, this is the one to take! The crew exemplified the saying “Do what you love but call it work.” Their enthusiasm, friendliness, and love of the natural beauty surrounding us made this a truly memorable evening.

This was an amazing experience. Really, I can't say enough good things. The team worked together to give us a wonderful morning of both relaxation and fun. If your vacation budget only really allows you to do one thing, this should be it!!
